results.title: Rebirth of the Living Dead
results.overview: Following the events of both "Night of The Living Dead" and "Return of The Living Dead", "Rebirth of The Living Dead" picks up nearly 50 years later in Los Angeles where "Trioxin Trash" is the new drug on the street. This "ultimate high" turns users into brain-craving Living Dead and it's up to a lone Scientist and a young couple to uncover the cure before it's too late.

results.title: Processing Charlie
results.overview: An act of kindness quickly becomes a nightmarish fight for survival when a young man, dealing with his fractured marriage, takes in a needy, long-lost cousin. Part pervert, part psychopath, Cousin Cole’s dark secrets slowly bubble to the surface as Charlie realizes too late that no good deed goes unpunished.

results.title: PSYCHO
results.overview: When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes. Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

results.title: Krypto Saves the Day!: Robo-Pal
results.overview: Lex Luthor deploys a robo-dog to hunt Superman and Supergirl, but the mission unravels when Krypto and the machine become best friends.

results.title: Crossing The Rhineland
results.overview: After a large attack on an American base in the Rhineland, Germany, SS Officer Heinrich Louzer is sent and makes it his main duty to capture and kill the ones who got away.

results.title: Абаасылаах хаус 2. Финал
results.overview: After the death of a friend, a group of young people travels to a cursed alaas to fulfill his final wish. However, instead of a simple farewell, they find themselves in a realm where the boundary between the living and the dead has all but vanished. To escape, they must confront otherworldly forces, find unexpected allies, and defeat an ancient evil. Beneath the series of wild, humorous, and perilous adventures lies a story about true friendship, self-sacrifice, and the courage to let go of those who can never return.

results.title: Un mal partido
results.overview: An overprotective father clashes with his daughter's boyfriend during a family trip, leading to comedic tension as he struggles to accept their relationship while trying to maintain control.

results.title: The Great Diamond Hunt
results.overview: Katja dreams of going on her dance team's trip to Gothenburg but can't afford it. When her eccentric grandmother Lydia, a former jewel thief just out of prison, turns up with a plan to find a stolen diamond bracelet hidden at the Bakken amusement park, Katja and her brothers join the hunt, racing a smuggler's henchman to the diamonds before the team leaves.

results.title: Soma: Envolution Begins
results.overview: khmer movie

results.title: Yasha
results.overview: Yasha follows Hana, a young teacher driven to desperate measures after losing her job. In need of money for her son’s life-saving operation, Hana is willing to endure any hardship, humiliation, or consequence to give her child a chance to survive, and the film remains firmly focused on its protagonist’s relentless struggle throughout. Never saccharine or manipulative in its portrayal of maternal determination, this is a story that feels raw, tense, and authentic.

results.title: Piedad Isla revelada
results.overview: Piedad Isla revelada turns to the photographer who made looking closely a way of preserving life in Cervera de Pisuerga. Moving through documentary photography, ethnographic curiosity and photojournalism, the film asks what remains of a rural world when the person who recorded it becomes part of its memory.

results.title: Tales of the Sea
results.overview: Two young men from different backgrounds, with different upbringings and life stories, find themselves lost on a boat in the middle of the Mediterranean Sea. They soon realize that the only way for them to survive is to set aside their differences and work together.

results.title: Unspoken Bond
results.overview: A feature documentary about a relationship often overlooked: the bond between humans and animals—not a substitute for human connection, but a profound one in its own right. Through three lives transformed by an animal, it reveals a bond that heals and connects us as deeply as any human relationship.

results.title: We Are Not Invisible: Doulas and the Work of Survival
results.original_title: We Are Not Invisible: Doulas and the Work of Survival
results.overview: Through doulas, mothers and medical professionals, the film explores pregnancy and birth through one first-time mother, alongside stories of medical crisis and insight. It reveals the unseen labor surrounding birth and the voices fighting to be heard, believed and valued.

results.title: Street Angel
results.overview: A hustler finds hope through his relationship with a faithful woman, until his violent past catches up with them. Set between barbershop, church, and streets, their story explores redemption's price.

results.title: The Protectors
results.overview: Living on his own for the first time, a 55-year old artist with disability creates a comic book to honor the protectors in his life, including his late father.

results.title: PHINDA
results.overview: In KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, retired schoolteacher Mama Zikhali gathers her class for one final lesson: the extraordinary 40-year story of Phinda, where pioneering conservationists, local communities and wildlife transformed a degraded landscape into one of Africa's oldest and most celebrated rewilding successes.

results.title: A Long Way to Go
results.overview: Exploring the human realities of immigration through the intertwined journeys of three women—nurses who leave their home countries, the Philippines, Ghana, and India, to join the healthcare workforce in the United States. Their stories illuminate the emotional, economic, and cultural complexities of migration, revealing what it means to live between worlds while sustaining deep ties to families and communities across continents.

results.title: Home from the Vietnam War
results.overview: Haunted by nightmares, a decorated U.S. veteran returns to Vietnam with a friend who fled the war as a child. Fifty-seven years later, they journey to one of the war's bloodiest battle sites, confronting the soldiers they once fought and long-buried memories in a powerful search for healing and reconciliation.

results.title: Unknown Author
results.overview: A Brazilian filmmaker in Berlin re-enacts past sexual abuse in different versions to process the trauma.
